import_provenance.original_title: Craig interpolation for Gödel logic with function symbols
import_provenance.original_statement: Does first-order Gödel logic with truth values [0,1], allowing function symbols and without built-in equality, have Craig interpolation? Whenever A entails B, the desired interpolant I must use only their common nonlogical symbols and satisfy A entails I and I entails B.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The relational-language case, with constants but no function symbols, was settled positively before the cutoff; the cited paper explicitly leaves this extension open.
